name: UK Sustainability Disclosure Requirements (SDR)
source: FCA Policy Statement PS23/16 — Sustainability Disclosure Requirements and investment labels
notes: UK SDR applies to UK-authorised investment products. Fund labels became available July 2024. Naming rules effective April 2025.

sustainabilityFocus.label: Sustainability Focus
sustainabilityFocus.description: Products investing in assets that are environmentally or socially sustainable

criteria.note: Assets must meet a credible standard of environmental sustainability — not just improving

sustainabilityImprovers.label: Sustainability Improvers
sustainabilityImprovers.description: Products investing in assets with potential to improve their sustainability over time

criteria.note: Must have a credible, time-bound improvement plan with measurable milestones

sustainabilityImpact.label: Sustainability Impact
sustainabilityImpact.description: Products aiming to achieve a pre-defined positive environmental or social impact

criteria.note: Must demonstrate additionality and measurable positive outcomes with independent verification

sustainabilityMixed.label: Sustainability Mixed Goals
sustainabilityMixed.description: Products with a mix of the above approaches

criteria.note: Applies a combination of the above criteria proportionate to each sleeve

namingRules.note: Products using these terms in fund names or marketing must hold the appropriate SDR label or demonstrate FCA-approved justification
